2.content: Assign a strong negative score to any move that would place the agent on a hazardous cell (H) or orthogonally adjacent to a hazard; this safety penalty must outweigh any positive score from distance reduction when moves offer equal Manhattan distance improvement.

3.content: Score moves based on reduction in Manhattan distance to the goal, giving higher scores to larger reductions; apply a strong penalty to any move that would place the agent on a hazardous cell (H) or adjacent to a hazard, and when multiple moves offer similar distance reductions, prefer the safer (non‑hazardous) option.
